messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1: need to finalize HelioSoft case study interview + webinar plan. Main asks: quote approvals, demo cadence in webinar, and inbound lead routing to AE queue. Draft brief here: https://redwood.docs/case-briefs/heliosoft
Ravi: I can coordinate interviews. Which spokes should we film? VP Eng + Head of Product?
Maya: Yes VP Eng for architecture impact, Head of Product for business outcomes. Also would like a 5-min live demo slot mid-webinar.
Clara: Working on pull-quote wording. Proposed: "HelioSoft cut inference costs materially after moving to Redwood." Too vague?
Owen: Better to aim for quantifiable language but only if Helio signs off in email. Otherwise "materially" is fine. Tag any percent with [LEGAL].
Clara: Added tags and looped in Legal. Draft consent checkbox on reg form: "I consent to being contacted by Redwood and to recordings of the webinar for marketing purposes." Thoughts?
Sam: That copy is good. I'll wire the registration webhook to SFDC campaign 'Helio-Q2-Web' and set lead owner to queue helio-ae. Also add a hidden field for webinar consent true/false.
Maya: Great. Legal deadline: please get signoff by May 6 so we can hit embargo May 14. If Helio asks for transcript redactions we may need an extra 2-4 days.
Ravi: Proposed interview times: Tue 10am, Wed 2pm, Thu 9am PT. Sending Doodle now. Need to confirm whether Helio legal requires an NDA for transcripts.
Owen: If they request NDA, ping me. I can fast-track a one-way ND amendment but it may push the publish date.
Clara: Sent quote to Helio for redline. Also asked for explicit permission to include a percent reduction; awaiting reply.
deploy-bot: calendar event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=heliosoft-webinar-1725009999
Sam: I've tested the webhook mapping in staging; will deploy to prod after we get registration page copy final.
Maya: Summary: interviews scheduled pending Doodle, legal tagged quote lines, reg form updated with consent, SFDC routing set to helio-ae, embargo target May 14. Check-in tomorrow EOD. :rocket:
